description: Named variables of the Romper's behaviour (chara/Romper/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: romper_prev_rot_y
fields.note: rot_y of the previous tick: a turn twists the body (romper_twist, bone 2).

fields.name: romper_accel
fields.note: Speed added every 30 fps tick; the walk and run cycles set it by keyframe.

fields.name: romper_cycle_time
fields.note: Time into the walk or run cycle the speed curve was integrated up to.

fields.name: romper_offset_x
fields.note: Slide of the body this tick (the lunge and the stun jump), added to the step.

fields.name: romper_pin_time
fields.note: Time into the landing clip of the pin (0 elsewhere).

fields.name: romper_home_z
fields.note: The spawn point the idle wander picks its targets around.

fields.name: romper_start_keyframe
fields.note: Keyframe offset into the cycle the run or the creep starts at.

fields.name: romper_lost_timer
fields.note: Time since Harry was last seen or heard.

fields.name: romper_bite_sound
fields.note: The bite landed this tick: its sound plays with the voices.

fields.name: romper_timer
fields.note: The chase's leap cooldown and the creep's steering timer.

fields.name: romper_pin_brake
fields.note: How fast the pin's slide onto Harry slows down.
